title: A curvilinear model grid

dataset.name: CMIP6 GFDL-ESM4 historical Omon tos, 50 km tripolar grid with 2D lon/lat (Pangeo Google Cloud bucket)

left.label: warp: ortho-cog-viewer / rwarp
left.note: Both renderers want a CRS and a geotransform. A tripolar grid has neither; it has 2D lon/lat arrays. There is no geolocation-array path in the browser yet.

gap: gridlook draws cells from geolocation arrays; the warp renderers need an affine grid, so a tripolar slice is invisible to them.
bridge: An anglr-style cell mesh built from the 2D lon/lat arrays as a third renderer behind the pluggable interface; GDAL's geoloc warper is the non-browser equivalent.
